desc: Ideate approaches and select per-vitamin knapsack + binary search on answer.
Parse input and group foods into three lists by vitamin type.
Compute per-vitamin 0/1 knapsack DP arrays over calories 0..X and ensure prefix-max/nondecreasing behavior.
Implement feasibility check for candidate T using bisect_left to find minimum calories per vitamin, with impossible thresholds treated as failure.
Binary search maximum T using upper bound min(total vitamin amount per group) + 1 and print result.
Test edge cases: missing vitamin type, all calories unused, large A_i, sample inputs, and performance for N=X=5000.
